description:
Influence score for a single X/Twitter account: a 0-100 score and follower count. Use it when the user asks about a specific influencer or KOL, or wants to know how much weight an account carries in crypto conversation. It is a per-account snapshot, not a topic aggregate.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

username.description: X/Twitter handle, with or without the leading @.

name: get_influence_score
